records.jp: え～！　陽桜莉さん、水着持ってきてないの？
records.en_original: Huh?! You didn't bring your swimsuit?
records.en_auxiliary: Huh?! You didn't bring your swimsuit?
records.en: What?! Hiori-san, you did not bring a swimsuit?

records.jp: ごめんね、愛央ちゃん！<CR>今日の水浴び、楽しみにしてたよね？
records.en_original: I'm sorry, Ao! You were looking forward to going in the pool, weren't you?
records.en_auxiliary: I'm sorry, Ao! You were looking forward to going in the pool, weren't you?
records.en: I'm sorry, Ao-chan! You were<CR>looking forward to going in the pool, weren't you?

records.jp: ちゃ、ちゃんと準備はしてたんだよ？<CR>さっき飲み物をこぼしちゃうまでは……なんだけど
records.en_original: I-I was getting everything ready, but then I spilled my drink, and...
records.en_auxiliary: I-I was getting everything ready, but then I spilled my drink, and...
records.en: I-I was getting everything ready,<CR>but then I spilled my drink, and...

records.jp: 陽桜莉さんらしいといえば、らしいけど。<CR>なんというか……ドンマイ！

records.en_auxiliary: Don't worry about it. It's very Hiori of you.
records.en: Don't worry about it. It's very<CR>Hiori-san of you.

records.jp: うーーー

records.en_auxiliary: *Sob*
records.en: *Sob*

records.jp: まあまあ、元気出して。<CR>水浴びはまた今度やろーよ
records.en_original: Hey, cheer up. We can go in the pool another time.
records.en_auxiliary: Hey, cheer up. We can go in the pool another time.
records.en: Hey, cheer up. We can go<CR>in the pool another time.

records.jp: ありがと、愛央ちゃん。<CR>でも……
records.en_original: Thanks, Ao. But...
records.en_auxiliary: Thanks, Ao. But...
records.en: Thanks, Ao-chan.<CR>But...

records.jp: ……これはおしおきが必要だね！
records.en_original: You must be punished!
records.en_auxiliary: You must be punished!
records.en: You must be punished!

records.jp: え～！　そんなぁ！
records.en_original: Wait, what?!
records.en_auxiliary: Wait, what?!
records.en: Wait, what?!

records.jp: 陽桜莉さんと遊ぶの、楽しみにしてたんだよ？<CR>ということで、次の皿洗い当番を替わること！
records.en_original: I was looking forward to hanging out with you! So, next time I'm on dishwashing duty, you must cover my shift!
records.en_auxiliary: I was looking forward to hanging out with you! So, next time I'm on dishwashing duty, you must cover my shift!
records.en: I was looking forward to hanging out with you, Hiori-san!<CR>So you have to take my next dishwashing shift!

records.jp: りょ、りょうか～い
records.en_original: Y-yes, ma'am!
records.en_auxiliary: Y-yes, ma'am!
records.en: Y-yes, ma'am!

records.jp: あはは、冗談冗談。<CR>手伝ってくれたら嬉しいけどね
records.en_original: Ahaha, just kidding. I wouldn't mind some help though.
records.en_auxiliary: Ahaha, just kidding. I wouldn't mind some help though.
records.en: Ahaha, just kidding.<CR>I wouldn't mind some help though.

records.jp: ううっ。今日はできないんだって思うと<CR>かえって無性に水浴びしたくなってきちゃった
records.en_original: Ugh. I just wish I could go in the pool! Knowing that I can't makes it worse!
records.en_auxiliary: Ugh. I just wish I could go in the pool! Knowing that I can't makes it worse!
records.en: Ugh. I just wish I could go in the<CR>pool! Knowing that I can't makes it worse!

records.jp: ……そうだ！　せめて手足だけでも<CR>シャワーを浴びたら少しは涼しくなるかも！
records.en_original: ...I know! I can at least cool my arms and legs in the shower!
records.en_auxiliary: ...I know! I can at least cool my arms and legs in the shower!
records.en: ...I know! I can at least cool<CR>my arms and legs in the shower!

records.jp: あっ、それいいね！<CR>じゃあさっそく、シャワーを弱く出して……
records.en_original: Oh, true! I'll just turn on the shower a little bit...
records.en_auxiliary: Oh, true! I'll just turn on the shower a little bit...
records.en: Oh, true! I'll just<CR>turn on the shower a little bit...

records.jp: ……は～っ、冷たくて気持ちいい！
records.en_original: Ahh... This feels so nice!
records.en_auxiliary: Ahh... This feels so nice!
records.en: Ahh... This feels so nice!

records.jp: 頭からバシャーッとは浴びれないけど、<CR>これはこれで満足！
records.en_original: Even if we can't dunk our heads, this is still pretty good!
records.en_auxiliary: Even if we can't dunk our heads, this is still pretty good!
records.en: Even if we can't dunk our heads, this is<CR>still pretty good!

records.jp: でも、ちょっと水の勢いが強いかな？<CR>服が濡れないように、もっと弱く……

records.en_auxiliary: The water pressure is a little high though. Better turn it down so our clothes don't get wet...
records.en: The water pressure is a little high though.<CR>Better turn it down so our clothes don't get wet...

records.jp: ひゃっ！？
records.en_original: Aaaah!
records.en_auxiliary: Aaaah!
records.en: Aaaah!

records.jp: ごめん……蛇口捻る方向、間違えた……
records.en_original: Sorry... I turned the knob the wrong way...
records.en_auxiliary: Sorry... I turned the knob the wrong way...
records.en: Sorry... I turned the knob the wrong way...

records.jp: ずぶ濡れになっちゃった
records.en_original: I'm soaked!
records.en_auxiliary: I'm soaked!
records.en: I'm soaked!

records.jp: み、水も滴るいい女だね！？<CR>あはは……はは……
records.en_original: Th-they say there's nothing more beautiful than a woman kissed by rain, right?! Ahaha...haha...
records.en_auxiliary: Th-they say there's nothing more beautiful than a woman kissed by rain, right?! Ahaha...haha...
records.en: A-a beautiful woman looks good even dripping wet, right!?<CR>Ahaha... haha...

records.jp: ごめんなさい
records.en_original: I'm sorry.
records.en_auxiliary: I'm sorry.
records.en: I'm sorry.

records.jp: ぷっ……あはは！
records.en_original: Pfft...ahaha!
records.en_auxiliary: Pfft...ahaha!
records.en: Pfft...ahaha!

records.jp: 愛央ちゃんも意外と失敗するんだね？<CR>なんか親近感わいちゃうなあ
records.en_original: Even you make mistakes, huh, Ao? For some reason that makes me feel closer to you.
records.en_auxiliary: Even you make mistakes, huh, Ao? For some reason that makes me feel closer to you.
records.en: Even you make mistakes, huh, Ao-chan? For some<CR>reason that makes me feel closer to you.

records.jp: はは……でも本当にごめんね。<CR>すぐに二人分のタオル、持ってくるから
records.en_original: Haha... I am really sorry though. I'll go get us some towels.
records.en_auxiliary: Haha... I am really sorry though. I'll go get us some towels.
records.en: Haha... I am really sorry<CR>though. I'll go get us some towels.

records.jp: あ、待って
records.en_original: Well, hang on.
records.en_auxiliary: Well, hang on.
records.en: Well, hang on.

records.jp: 愛央ちゃん？　どうしたの？
records.en_original: Ao? What's wrong?
records.en_auxiliary: Ao? What's wrong?
records.en: Ao-chan? What's wrong?

records.jp: なるほど。<CR>陽桜莉さん、色はそういうのが好きなんだ
records.en_original: I see. You like that color, huh?
records.en_auxiliary: I see. You like that color, huh?
records.en: I see. So<CR>you like those kinds of colors, Hiori-san.

records.jp: 色？　一体何の……
records.en_original: What color? What are you talking abou—
records.en_auxiliary: What color? What are you talking abou—
records.en: What color? What are you talking abou—

records.jp: ……あっ！
records.en_original: ...Aah!
records.en_auxiliary: ...Aah!
records.en: ...Aah!

records.jp: 愛央ちゃんのえっち！<CR>こっち見ちゃだめ！
records.en_original: Ao, you perv! Don't look at me!
records.en_auxiliary: Ao, you perv! Don't look at me!
records.en: Ao-chan, you perv!<CR>Don't look at me!

records.jp: はっ！？<CR>私ってば、つい！　ご、ごめん！
records.en_original: Huh?! I was just... I-I'm sorry!
records.en_auxiliary: Huh?! I was just... I-I'm sorry!
records.en: Huh?! I<CR>was just... I-I'm sorry!

records.jp: まあ、気になっちゃう気持ちは<CR>分からないでもないけどね
records.en_original: I mean... Not that I don't understand your curiosity...
records.en_auxiliary: I mean... Not that I don't understand your curiosity...
records.en: I mean... Not that I don't<CR>understand your curiosity...

records.jp: 愛央ちゃん、ここまで来たら、<CR>もうこのまま水浴びしちゃおっか？
records.en_original: Now that we've come this far, why don't we just jump in the water like this?
records.en_auxiliary: Now that we've come this far, why don't we just jump in the water like this?
records.en: Ao-chan, now that we have come this<CR>far, shall we just go swimming like this?

records.jp: 日差しはこーんなに照り付けてるし<CR>制服は完全に濡れちゃったし
records.en_original: It's really sunny out today, and our uniforms are completely soaked anyway.
records.en_auxiliary: It's really sunny out today, and our uniforms are completely soaked anyway.
records.en: It's really sunny out today, and our uniforms<CR>are completely soaked anyway.

records.jp: 制服は私のせいだけどね……！<CR>でも……賛成！

records.en_auxiliary: That was all my fault, but...Sure! I'm in!
records.en: That was all my fault,<CR>but...Sure! I'm in!

records.jp: あはは！<CR>ふたりともびしょびしょだねえ
records.en_original: Ahaha! Now we're both soaking wet!
records.en_auxiliary: Ahaha! Now we're both soaking wet!
records.en: Ahaha!<CR>Now we're both soaking wet!

records.jp: こんなふうに遊ぶの、初めてかも。<CR>普段と全然違って、なんか、すごく楽しい！
records.en_original: I've never done anything like this. I never thought it'd be this much fun!
records.en_auxiliary: I've never done anything like this. I never thought it'd be this much fun!
records.en: I've never done anything like this.<CR>I never thought it'd be this much fun!

records.jp: 私も楽しい！
records.en_original: I know, right?!
records.en_auxiliary: I know, right?!
records.en: I know, right?!

records.jp: 愛央ちゃん、また今度一緒に遊ぼうね！

records.en_auxiliary: Let's hang out again sometime, okay?
records.en: Ao-chan, let us play together again sometime!

records.en_original: Yeah. What should we do next time?
records.en_auxiliary: Yeah. What should we do next time?
records.en: Yeah. What should we do next time?

records.en_auxiliary: Yeah, hmm... Hehe. It's fun just thinking about it.
records.en: Yeah, hmm... Hehe. It's fun just thinking about it.

records.en_auxiliary: I'm actually getting a little cold...
records.en: I'm actually getting a little cold...

records.en_original: Huh?!
records.en_auxiliary: Huh?!
records.en: Huh?!

records.en: Th-that's no good! You'll catch a cold! Let's hurry up<CR>and get some dry clothes on you!

records.en_auxiliary: Ahaha... Yeah, good idea. ...Aaah-choo!
records.en: Ahaha... Yeah, good idea. ...Aaah-choo!

records.en_auxiliary: Have you already caught one?! The nurse's office...medicine...!
records.en: Have you already caught one?! The nurse's<CR>office...medicine...!

records.en_auxiliary: I'll carry you there, Ao! Get on my back!
records.en: I'll carry you there, Ao-chan!<CR>Get on my back!

records.en: Whoa whoa! You don't need to go that far!
